mapper.select: SELECT * FROM work_type_view where site_id = #{site_id} ORDER BY t_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO w_type(t_name, useyn, gubun, site_id, writer_user_id, write_time) VALUES ( #{t_name}, 'Y', #{gubun}, #{site_id}, #{writer_user_id}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE gubun = #{gubun}, useyn = 'Y', writer_user_id = #{writer_user_id}, write_time = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE w_type set useyn = 'N', write_time = now(), writer_user_id = #{writer_user_id} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT ws.*, u.name as writer_name FROM work_state ws LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = ws.u_id WHERE site_id = #{site_id} AND ws.useyn = 'Y' AND (ws.id >= 0 AND ws.id != 99) ORDER BY ws.id = 0 DESC
SELECT ws.*, u.name as writer_name FROM work_state ws LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = ws.u_id WHERE site_id = #{site_id} AND ws.useyn = 'Y' ORDER BY id DESC

mapper.update: UPDATE work_state set useyn = 'N', write_time = now(), u_id = #{u_id} WHERE id = #{id}
